inputs.text: [excited] Al… oh… saurus. [curious] "Allo," in Greek, means other, different — its bones didn't look like any other dinosaur's. [serious] And "saurus" means lizard.
[confident] The lizard… hello? Like on the phone?

[chuckles] Almost the same word, but this one means different, not hi. [serious] The different lizard. It lived in North America, [confident] but also in Europe, [amazed] one hundred fifty-five million years ago.
[curious] On two continents at the same time?
[confident] Exactly. [proud] The top hunter of the Jurassic, on both sides of the ocean.
